question: How much armour and how much dragon.

options.label: A
options.name: Dented plate: visor up, wings folded, grey-tipped tail
options.question: Mostly armour: a full harness, the dragon only at the snout, horns, wings and tail.
parts: wings (clay_cool membrane, ash bone): layer 0; back; folded behind the pauldrons in S, one shape over the back in E/W; flick open 2 px on react and cheer
tail (clay scales, last third ash, one lava ember): layer 1; hip; behind the legs, sways a frame behind the walk, curls round her in the nap
far leg / near leg (slate cuisse, slate_warm knee cop, slate_cool greave, iron sabaton): layers 2/4; hip; 6-frame walk
tassets (slate_warm over iron, two lames a side) and belt (iron): layer 5; hip; squash on hop
cuirass (slate, centre ridge, two dents): layer 6; hip; breath 1 px
bell (brass, small) on an iron strap: layer 7; belt front, her left, in every facing; swings a frame behind; tolls at three heat (cast)
arms (slate vambraces, iron couter and gauntlet): layer 8; chest; swing, guard, wind-up
pauldrons (slate dome, slate_cool lame, dent, brass rivet): layer 9; chest; ride up in the fidget and guard
head (slate sallet with a raised slate_warm visor, ash horns, clay drake face): layer 10; chest; visor drops for guard (visor part), eyes blink in the face opening
options.pose: Square and planted, gauntlets loose at her sides, chin up under the raised visor: the night watch nobody has to remind. Fidget: rolls her left shoulder, eyes shut, plates clink.
notes: Works: the most knightly silhouette (domed shoulders, horned helm, wings over the shoulders); reads as armour first at 2 device px.
Risk: little dragon shows (snout, horns, tail), and an all-metal body is cold beside the warm folk; the wings add a part to every frame.
Compared with Eastward 05 at the same height (John, Sam, the townsfolk): one dark outline, a lit cap and dark crescent per part, 4 to 5 tones a material, 2 x 3 eyes with a glint.

options.label: B
options.name: Half-plate drake: breastplate and one pauldron, bare scaly arms, big horns
options.question: Half and half: a breastplate over a quilted gambeson, the dragon in the head, arms and tail.
parts: tail (clay scales, lava ember at the tip, 2 px glow): layer 0; hip; long, sways behind the walk, wraps the nap; the ember dims as heat drops
far arm (clay, a tone back): layer 1; chest; swings opposite the near leg
legs (ashlar_cool breeches, slate greaves and boots): layers 2/3; hip; 6-frame walk
gambeson (ashlar, quilted, to mid-thigh): layer 4; hip; the hem sways a frame behind
belt (ash) and bell (brass): layer 5; belt front, her left; swings, tolls on cast
breastplate (slate, ridge, dent, brass rivets): layer 6; chest; breath 1 px
near arm (bare clay scales, slate bracer, ash claws; her left upper arm greying to ash): layer 7; chest; swing, haymaker strike, fan in the fidget
pauldron (slate, her left shoulder only, one lame): layer 8; chest; braces in guard
head (clay, swept ash horns, cheek frills, spine crest): layer 9; chest; smoke puff spawns at the snout (hand anchor for the fidget)
options.pose: A bruiser at ease, arms hanging heavy, weight back on her heels, horns high. Fidget: blows a tiny smoke puff and fans it away with a clawed hand.
notes: Works: the most dragon for a 52 px knight: big horns and frills make a silhouette no other folk has, the bare arms say Bruiser, the one pauldron gives a lopsided read.
Risk: clay scales sit near Bramble's fox in hue; the ashlar gambeson and slate keep the mass grey-cool, and the horns must stay inside the 64 px cell in every pose.
Compared with Eastward 05 (John's bulk and backpack read as one block with a lit edge).

options.label: C
options.name: Hearth squire: kettle hat, quilted surcoat, big belt bell, ember-tipped tail
options.question: Least armour: a squire's light kit, a big round drake head under a wide iron brim.
parts: tail (clay scales, curled up behind the hip, lava ember tip): layer 0; hip; the tip bobs on the breath and lights brighter with heat
far arm (clay, a tone back): layer 1; chest
legs (ash breeches, timber boots with cuffs): layers 2/3; hip; 6-frame walk
surcoat (ash, quilted, clay hearth badge): layer 4; hip; hem sways
belt (timber) and big bell (brass, 9 px): layer 5; belt front, her left; swings wide on the walk, the hand rests on it in the fidget
near arm (clay scales, iron vambrace; her left upper arm greying): layer 6; chest
spaulders and gorget (iron, small, one dent): layer 7; chest
head (big round clay drake head, stubby ash horns): layer 8; chest
kettle hat (iron crown, wide iron brim with a hard shadow on the brow): layer 9; head; tips back on cheer, down over the eyes in the nap
options.pose: Earnest and a little sleepy, feet together, the bell kept still with a glance. Fidget: lays a hand on the big bell to quiet it, eyes lowered.
notes: Works: the wide brim is a shape nobody else owns and reads instantly; the big bell is her signature at any size; cosiest of the three.
Risk: least knight and least Bruiser; the brim crowds the familiar perch on the shoulder.
Compared with Eastward 05 (Sam: a big head over a small body, hair as lobes; the brim shadow follows Eastward's hard shadow under hat brims).

final.name: Half-plate drake (final): ember scales, one pauldron as the perch, the big bedtime bell
grafts: From C: the big brass bell (9 x 7 art px, lit rim, waist band, clapper) at the belt front on her left, the same anchor and layer in every facing; it reads at game scale.
From A: dents drawn as dents, a dark upper crescent with turned-down tips over a lit lower lip, one or two a plate, never mottling.
Scales moved off Bramble's fox orange: deep ember red-brown, clay tones 1 to 3 leading (4 only on the snout ridge and knuckles), the greying patch in ash on her left upper arm.
Tail cut short and curled up beside her legs, ember tip; never more than 10 art px behind her heel.
The one pauldron (her left shoulder) sits at the back of the shoulders in profile, a flat lit ledge: in fights it is the shoulder away from the foe and the familiar perches on it.
parts: tail (clay ember scales, lava glow tip 2 px): layer 0; hip; curls up beside the legs in every facing (S: screen right; E/W: behind the heel, at most 10 px back); bobs a frame behind the breath; round the front in the nap; the tip dims as heat drops
far arm (clay, a tone back, slate_cool bracer): layer 1; chest; E: her left (greying), W: her right
far leg / near leg (ashlar_cool breeches, slate greave, slate_cool boot): layers 2/3; hip; 6-frame walk, lunge in strike, forward in sit
gambeson (ashlar, quilted channels, to mid-thigh): layer 4; hip; hem sways a frame behind
belt (ash) and big bell (brass 9 x 7): layer 5; belt front, her left, all facings; swings a frame behind, rings on the third heat (cast)
breastplate (slate, ridge, one dent, brass rivets): layer 6; chest; breath 1 px
familiar (stand-in Mossling, 24 px): layer 6.5; perched on the pauldron ledge in fight poses
pauldron (slate, her left shoulder only, lame, dent): layer 7; chest; S: screen right; E: far, back of the shoulders; W: near, back of the shoulders; the perch ledge (flat lit top)
near arm (bare clay scales, round shoulder, slate_cool bracer, fist with ash claws): layer 8; chest; E: her right with an ash strap over the bare shoulder, W: her left (greying); haymaker, guard, fan
head (clay, swept ash horns, brow ridge, cheek frill, snout step, spine crest): layer 9; chest; ember breath spawns at the snout tip (cast), smoke puff (fidget)
final.pose: A bruiser at ease, arms hanging heavy, weight back on her heels, horns high; she fights with her fists and breathes a banked ember to cast. Fidget: a tiny smoke puff, fanned away.
notes: Compared side by side with Eastward 05 at the same character height (John, Sam and the townsfolk by the trailers): one dark outline per material, a lit cap and dark crescent per part, 4 to 5 tones a material, 2 x 3 eyes with a glint, John's bulk read as one block with a lit edge.
Ember red-brown scales against cool slate and pale ashlar keep her apart from Bramble's orange fox; horns, frills and the single pauldron make a silhouette no other folk has.
The perch is the pauldron at the back of the shoulders; the 24 px stand-in Mossling covers the back horn in fights (the familiar size is still open for Matt).
Open: whether the cast should ring the bell (her mechanic) rather than breathe an ember; the scale texture on bare arms is the costliest layer per frame.
